perks.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

enhanced.description: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine. Increases time between precision shots.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Grave Robber
enhanced.description: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves. Improves handling.

perks.name: Bewildering Burst
perks.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.

enhanced.name: Bewildering Burst
enhanced.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a longer-lasting disorienting blast.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

enhanced.name: Rapid Hit
enhanced.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed substantially.

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.

enhanced.name: Proximity Power
enhanced.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant an improved amount of bonus Melee stat.

perks.description: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

enhanced.name: Opening Shot
enhanced.description: Greatly improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.description: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

enhanced.name: Closing Time
enhanced.description: Further improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

enhanced.name: Sword Logic
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

enhanced.name: Swashbuckler
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage for an improved duration from melee final blows and defeating targets with this weapon.

perks.name: Ancillary Ordinance
perks.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. Multiple missiles can be prepared.

enhanced.name: Ancillary Ordinance
enhanced.description: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. More missiles can be prepared.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Binary Orbit
enhanced.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: All-Star
perks.description:

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.

enhanced.name: All-Star
